landing.missionText: I created Föräldrahjälpen so that every child can have the same chance to succeed in school, no matter the conditions at home. Parents have different time, school backgrounds, language confidence, and familiarity with today's teaching methods. With new technology, I want to reduce that gap by making support clear, educational, and accessible for everyone.
landing.featureAiHelp: AI homework help in all subjects
landing.howWeHelp: How we help you with homework
landing.howWeHelpDesc: Föräldrahjälpen makes it easy to support your child in school, whether you've forgotten how to solve equations or never learned about Lgr22.
landing.step1Title: Ask a question or photo the homework
landing.step1Desc: Type your question in the chat or take a photo with your phone. The AI understands both text and images — from math problems to essays.
landing.step2Desc: The AI explains step by step, adapted to the child's grade. Every answer is linked to the core content of Lgr22.
landing.step3Desc: Add homework to the weekly calendar with deadlines and work days. Share the plan with another parent.
landing.allSubjectsDesc: Föräldrahjälpen supports all subjects your child has in school, from math and Swedish to science and social studies. The AI adapts explanations to grades 1-9.
landing.whyParentsNeedHelp: Why do parents need homework help?
landing.whyParentsDesc: Schoolwork looks different today compared to when you were in school. The curriculum has changed, methods are new, and it can be hard to keep up.
landing.reason1Desc: Lgr22 introduced new core content and skills. Föräldrahjälpen links every explanation to current curriculum content so you know the information matches what school teaches.
landing.reason2Desc: Number lines, area models, place value systems — math methods have changed. With Föräldrahjälpen you can quickly understand how the child is expected to solve the task and explain it the right way.
landing.reason3Desc: With a shared calendar both parents can track homework and deadlines, regardless of where the child lives that week. Perfect for shared custody.
landing.reason4Desc: Whether you have university courses in math or never finished primary school — Föräldrahjälpen gives you the tools to support your child educationally.
landing.freeToUseDesc: Föräldrahjälpen is free to use. Subscription plans may come later.
landing.likeTheApp: Like the app? You can support the project via Swish in the app.
landing.readyToHelpDesc: Create a free account and try Föräldrahjälpen today. No payment required.
landing.footerTagline: Föräldrahjälpen — AI-powered homework help linked to the Swedish curriculum Lgr22
landing.footerSeo: Help with homework in math, Swedish, English, science and social studies for grades 1-9
landing.pedagogicalDesc: Support for parents, not cheating for students.
landing.swedishSchoolDesc: Adapted to the Swedish curriculum Lgr22.

info.title: How It Works
info.subtitle: Föräldrahjälpen — your AI assistant for homework help
info.feature1Desc: Type your question in the chat and get an educational explanation.
info.feature2Desc: Take a photo of the homework with your phone — the AI analyzes the task.
info.feature3Desc: Use the weekly planner to organize your child's homework.
info.feature4Desc: Save good explanations in the library to come back to them.
info.feature5Desc: Invite the other parent so you can both follow the homework and planning.
info.feature6Desc: Your data is stored securely and never shared with third parties.
info.quickStep1: Create a free account and add your child with name and grade.
info.quickStep2: Ask a question in the chat or take a photo of the homework with the camera button.
info.quickStep3: Read the educational explanation and help your child understand the task.
info.section1Title: The AI chat — ask questions about homework
info.section1P1: The AI chat is the heart of Föräldrahjälpen. Here you can ask questions about all primary school subjects and get educational explanations adapted to the child's grade.
info.section1P2: Describe what the child needs help with. The more details, the better the answer.
info.section1P3: Answers are automatically adapted to the child's grade.
info.section1P4: Every answer is linked to the core content of the curriculum.
info.section1P5: Enable 'Simple Swedish' to get answers with simpler words and shorter sentences.
info.section1P6: Click 'Deep dive' to get a more detailed explanation.
info.section2Title: Photo homework — image analysis with AI
info.section2P1: Take a photo of the homework with your phone and the AI will analyze the task and explain how you can help the child.
info.section2P2: Press the camera button in the chat to take a photo or choose an image from the gallery.
info.section2P3: The AI can read handwritten text, printed assignments, diagrams and images.
info.section2P4: The image is analyzed in seconds and you get an educational explanation.
info.section3P1: Use the weekly planner to keep track of all homework, tests and projects.
info.section3P2: Create tasks with subject, description, due date and work days.
info.section3P3: See all homework in a weekly calendar with a clear overview.
info.section3P4: Check off tasks as you go and track progress.
info.section3P5: Use test mode to create study plans before tests.
info.section3P6: Invite the other parent so you both can keep track of homework.
info.section4Title: The resource library — save and find
info.section4P1: Save good explanations and AI-generated illustrations in the library so you can find them again.
info.section4P2: Click 'Save to library' on an AI answer to save it.
info.section4P3: Search among saved resources or filter by images and texts.
info.section4P4: Share saved explanations with the other parent.
info.section5P1: The AI can create educational illustrations that make it easier to understand difficult concepts.
info.section5P2: Click 'Illustrate' on an AI answer to create an image.
info.section5P3: Images are adapted to the subject and the child's grade.
info.section5P4: All illustrations are saved in the resource library.
info.section6P1: Föräldrahjälpen makes it easy for separated parents to collaborate on the children's homework.
info.section6P2: Go to 'Manage children' and add the other parent's email address.
info.section6P3: Both parents get access to planning, chat history and library.
info.section7P1: Every answer in the AI chat is linked to the core content of the curriculum Lgr22, so you as a parent know the information matches what school teaches.
info.section7P2: See exactly which parts of the curriculum the homework covers.
info.section8P1: Föräldrahjälpen can help you check answers and prepare the child for tests.
info.section8P2: Click 'Show answer key' to see the correct answer with explanation.
info.section8P3: Create a study plan adapted to the test content.
info.section8P4: Print the answer key or study plan for offline use.
info.section9P1: We take your privacy seriously. Here is how we handle your data.
info.section9P2: We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics.
info.section9P3: All data is stored securely via Firebase with encryption.
info.section9P4: We comply with GDPR and you can delete your account and all data at any time.
info.section9P5: We never sell your data to third parties.
info.section10P1: Here are some tips to get the most out of Föräldrahjälpen.
info.section10P2: The more details you provide in your question, the better and more relevant the answer.
info.section10P3: Make sure the child's grade is correct — it affects the difficulty level of the answers.
info.section10P4: Taking a photo of the homework often gives better answers than typing out the assignment.
info.section10P5: Save explanations you like in the library so you can come back to them.
info.faq1Q: Is it cheating to use AI for homework?
info.faq1A: No! Föräldrahjälpen doesn't give ready answers. It explains concepts so you as a parent can support your child.
info.faq2A: All primary school subjects — math, Swedish, English, science, social studies, and more.
info.faq3Q: How does it work with the curriculum?
info.faq3A: Every answer is linked to the core content of Lgr22 so you understand why the child is learning this.
info.faq4A: The basic version is free to use.
info.faq5Q: Can I use the app on my phone?
info.faq5A: Yes! Föräldrahjälpen works as a web app and can be installed on your home screen — on both iPhone and Android.
info.faq6Q: Can both parents use the app?
info.faq6A: Yes, you can invite the other parent via 'Manage children'. You will then share planning, chat history and library.
info.footerLine1: Föräldrahjälpen — AI-powered homework help for parents
info.footerLine2: Linked to the curriculum Lgr22 for grades 1–9

install.title: Install App
install.alreadyInstalledDesc: You're already running Föräldrahjälpen as an app.
install.modalSubtitle: Add Föräldrahjälpen to your home screen or as a desktop app — faster access and better offline use.
install.afterNativeHint: If no dialog appears, follow the steps for your device below.
install.iosIntro: Use Safari. Open foraldrahjalpen.se — in-app browsers often lack Add to Home Screen.
install.iosTapShare: Tap Share (square with arrow). On iPhone it is often at the bottom; on iPad often top right near the address bar.
install.iosAddHome: Scroll the share sheet and tap Add to Home Screen (wording may vary slightly).
install.iosSafariTip: Using Chrome or another browser on iOS? Copy the address or open foraldrahjalpen.se in Safari — that is where Apple enables home screen installation for web apps.
install.androidIntro: Prefer Chrome or Samsung Internet. If you see an Install button at the top of this guide, use it first. Otherwise:
install.androidMenu: Tap the ⋮ menu (usually top right; in some browsers at the bottom)
install.androidAdd: Choose Add to Home screen, Install app, or similar
install.androidSamsungHint: Samsung Internet: menu → Add page to → Home screen (or similar).
install.desktopWithButtonIntro: Use the green button above if your browser offers installation. If nothing happens, open the section for Chrome, Edge, or Safari below.
install.desktopNoButtonIntro: Your browser is not showing an automatic install prompt here. Open the section for the browser you use — usually Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
install.desktopNote: On Mac, a recent macOS version is often required for Add to Dock. Update macOS and Safari if the menu item is missing.
install.safariStep1: With foraldrahjalpen.se open, choose File → Add to Dock (older macOS may say Add to Desktop or "Add to Dock" under a different name).
install.safariStep2: Confirm with Add. The app opens in its own window and appears in the Dock.
install.firefoxNote: Firefox has limited support for installing web apps on desktop. Use Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Safari to install Föräldrahjälpen.
install.chromeStep1: Click the install icon in the address bar (to the right) — it looks like a monitor with a download arrow
install.chromeStep2: Click Install in the dialog that appears
install.edgeStep1: Look for the app icon in the address bar — a small monitor with a download arrow
install.desktopFallback: No install icon? Click the menu (⋯) and select "Apps" → "Install this site as an app".
install.offlineNote: The app works offline and updates automatically
install.installBannerDesc: Add the app to your home screen for quick access.
